blocks.zh: 導論、一般程序與控制
blocks.en: Introduction, General Procedures and Controls

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 USP ⟨62⟩ 的定位：針對非無菌產品中特定微生物的檢測方法（⟨61⟩ 是計數，⟨62⟩ 是鑑別）
blocks.en: Understand the positioning of USP ⟨62⟩: test methods for specified microorganisms in nonsterile products (⟨61⟩ enumerates; ⟨62⟩ detects and identifies)

blocks.zh: 掌握測試前準備步驟：樣品製備、抗菌活性中和、表面活性劑毒性確認
blocks.en: Master the pre-test preparation steps: sample preparation, neutralization of antimicrobial activity, and confirmation that surfactants are not toxic to the test organisms

blocks.zh: 理解測試菌株的來源、培養條件與使用期限要求
blocks.en: Understand the requirements for the source, culture conditions and maximum age of test strains

blocks.zh: 掌握培養基的三大驗證特性：生長促進性（Growth Promoting）、抑制性（Inhibitory）、指示性（Indicative）
blocks.en: Master the three properties used to qualify culture media: growth promoting, inhibitory and indicative

blocks.zh: 理解陰性對照的意義與失敗時的調查要求
blocks.en: Understand the purpose of the negative control and the investigation required when it fails

blocks.zh: 掌握測試方法適用性驗證（Suitability of the Test Method）的邏輯與執行時機
blocks.en: Master the logic and timing of the Suitability of the Test Method

blocks.zh: 0.1 Introduction — 導論
blocks.en: 0.1 Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: USP ⟨62⟩ 的定位：這是一個定性/半定量檢測章節，目的是確認產品中是否存在特定的「不良微生物」（Objectionable Organisms）。它與 ⟨61⟩（微生物計數）是一對姐妹章節：
blocks.en: Positioning of USP ⟨62⟩: This is a qualitative/semi-quantitative chapter whose purpose is to confirm whether specified "objectionable organisms" are present in the product. It is a sister chapter to ⟨61⟩ (microbial enumeration):

blocks.zh: ⟨61⟩ — 回答「有多少？」（Total Aerobic Microbial Count, TAMC / Total Yeast & Mold Count, TYMC）
blocks.en: ⟨61⟩ answers "How many?" (Total Aerobic Microbial Count, TAMC / Total Yeast & Mold Count, TYMC)

blocks.zh: ⟨62⟩ — 回答「有沒有這些特定的壞傢伙？」（E. coli, Salmonella, P. aeruginosa, S. aureus, Clostridia, C. albicans）
blocks.en: ⟨62⟩ answers "Are these specific bad actors present?" (E. coli, Salmonella, P. aeruginosa, S. aureus, Clostridia, C. albicans)

blocks.zh: USP ⟨62⟩ 是強制性章節（<1000），適用於所有非無菌藥品。這不是建議，是法定要求。
blocks.en: USP ⟨62⟩ is a mandatory chapter (numbered below 1000) and applies to all nonsterile drug products. This is not a recommendation; it is a legal requirement.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 機場安檢的兩道關卡：
blocks.en: Two checkpoints at an airport:

blocks.zh: 想像 ⟨61⟩ 就像機場入口的人流計數器 — 它告訴你有多少人進了航站大廳。而 ⟨62⟩ 則像安檢門後的通緝犯辨識系統 — 它專門找特定的「危險人物」。即使人流量（⟨61⟩ 計數）在規格內，只要發現一個通緝犯（⟨62⟩ 指定微生物），整批貨都不合格。
blocks.en: Think of ⟨61⟩ as the people counter at the airport entrance: it tells you how many people came into the terminal. ⟨62⟩ is like the system behind the security gate that identifies wanted criminals: it looks only for specific "dangerous persons". Even if the crowd size (the ⟨61⟩ count) is within specification, finding a single wanted criminal (a ⟨62⟩ specified microorganism) means the whole batch fails.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 替代方法可以使用，但需證明等效：原文明確允許使用替代微生物方法（如快速微生物檢測系統 RMM），但前提是必須證明其與藥典方法等效。這在 CDMO 環境中非常重要 — 客戶可能要求使用特定的快速方法來縮短放行時間。
blocks.en: Alternative methods may be used, but equivalence must be demonstrated: The text explicitly allows alternative microbiological methods (such as rapid microbial methods, RMM), provided they are shown to be equivalent to the compendial method. This matters a great deal in a CDMO setting, where a client may ask for a specific rapid method to shorten release time.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：作為充填代工廠，你的進料檢測（incoming material testing）通常需要執行 ⟨61⟩ + ⟨62⟩。如果原料供應商提供的 CoA 不包含 ⟨62⟩ 測試結果，你可能需要自行檢測或要求供應商補充。
blocks.en: CDMO practice: As a fill-finish contract manufacturer, your incoming material testing usually needs to cover ⟨61⟩ + ⟨62⟩. If a raw material supplier's CoA does not include ⟨62⟩ results, you may need to test the material yourself or ask the supplier to provide them.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼非無菌產品也需要檢測特定微生物？無菌產品不是已經更嚴格了嗎？（提示：想想口服固體劑型中的 Salmonella 風險）
blocks.en: Why do nonsterile products also need testing for specified microorganisms? Aren't sterile products already held to a stricter standard? (Hint: think about the Salmonella risk in oral solid dosage forms.)

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 收到一批原料，⟨61⟩ 計數合格但 ⟨62⟩ 發現 E. coli。你會如何處理？拒收？讓步接受？
blocks.en: Your CDMO receives a raw material batch that passes the ⟨61⟩ count but shows E. coli in ⟨62⟩. How would you handle it? Reject? Accept under concession?

blocks.zh: 0.2 General Procedures — 一般程序
blocks.en: 0.2 General Procedures

blocks.zh: ⟨62⟩ 與 ⟨61⟩ 共用樣品製備：這個設計很聰明 — 你不需要為 ⟨62⟩ 開發一套全新的樣品製備方法。⟨61⟩ 的樣品製備程序（稀釋、溶解、均質化）同樣適用於 ⟨62⟩。
blocks.en: ⟨62⟩ shares sample preparation with ⟨61⟩: This is a smart design. You do not need to develop a completely new sample preparation method for ⟨62⟩. The ⟨61⟩ sample preparation procedures (dilution, dissolution, homogenization) apply equally to ⟨62⟩.

blocks.zh: 三個關鍵前置條件：
blocks.en: Three key prerequisites:

blocks.zh: 樣品製備 — 依照 ⟨61⟩ 的方法進行 1:10 稀釋
blocks.en: Sample preparation — prepare a 1:10 dilution following the ⟨61⟩ method

blocks.zh: 抗菌活性中和 — 如果產品本身有殺菌/抑菌作用（如含防腐劑的製劑），必須先中和
blocks.en: Neutralization of antimicrobial activity — if the product itself is bactericidal or bacteriostatic (for example, a formulation containing a preservative), this must be neutralized first

blocks.zh: 表面活性劑無毒確認 — 如果使用界面活性劑幫助溶解樣品，必須確認它不會殺死或抑制目標微生物
blocks.en: Confirmation that surfactants are nontoxic — if a surfactant is used to help dissolve the sample, you must confirm that it does not kill or inhibit the target microorganisms

blocks.zh: 犯罪現場的證據採集：
blocks.en: Evidence collection at a crime scene:

blocks.zh: 想像你是法醫，要在犯罪現場尋找特定嫌犯的 DNA。首先，你要確保採集工具不會破壞 DNA（= 表面活性劑不能有毒性）。其次，如果現場有漂白水（= 抗菌成分），你要先處理掉它，否則它會降解你要找的證據。最後，你使用標準化的採集流程（= ⟨61⟩ 的樣品製備方法），確保結果可靠可重現。
blocks.en: Imagine you are a forensic scientist looking for a specific suspect's DNA at a crime scene. First, you must make sure your collection tools do not destroy the DNA (= the surfactant must not be toxic). Second, if bleach is present at the scene (= antimicrobial ingredients), you must deal with it first, or it will degrade the evidence you are looking for. Finally, you use a standardized collection procedure (= the ⟨61⟩ sample preparation method) so that the results are reliable and reproducible.

blocks.zh: 抗菌活性中和是最常見的驗證失敗原因：在 CDMO 環境中，很多外用製劑（乳膏、凝膠）含有防腐劑（如 Methylparaben、Phenoxyethanol）。如果不充分中和這些成分，測試會得到「假陰性」結果 — 看起來沒有特定微生物，其實是被產品殺死了。
blocks.en: Insufficient neutralization of antimicrobial activity is the most common cause of validation failure: In a CDMO setting, many topical products (creams, gels) contain preservatives (such as methylparaben or phenoxyethanol). If these are not adequately neutralized, the test gives a "false negative": it looks as if the specified microorganisms are absent when in fact the product killed them.

blocks.zh: 這也是為什麼 USP 要求做方法適用性驗證（Suitability） — 你必須證明在產品存在的情況下，仍然能檢測到目標微生物。
blocks.en: This is also why USP requires method suitability testing — you must show that the target microorganisms can still be detected in the presence of the product.

blocks.zh: 如果一個含 0.1% Benzalkonium chloride 的眼用製劑需要做 ⟨62⟩ 測試，你會怎麼處理抗菌活性？列出可能的中和劑。
blocks.en: If an ophthalmic product containing 0.1% benzalkonium chloride needs ⟨62⟩ testing, how would you deal with its antimicrobial activity? List possible neutralizing agents.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 ⟨62⟩ 不自己定義樣品製備方法，而是引用 ⟨61⟩？這種設計有什麼好處和風險？
blocks.en: Why does ⟨62⟩ refer to ⟨61⟩ for sample preparation instead of defining its own method? What are the benefits and risks of this design?

blocks.zh: 0.3 Preparation of Test Strains & Negative Control — 測試菌株製備與陰性對照
blocks.en: 0.3 Preparation of Test Strains & Negative Control

blocks.zh: Seed-Lot System（種批系統）：這是微生物學實驗室品質管理的基石。就像藥品生產中的批次管理一樣，測試用的菌株也需要嚴格的「世代管理」：
blocks.en: Seed-lot system: This is the cornerstone of quality management in a microbiology laboratory. Just like batch control in drug manufacturing, test strains also need strict "generation control":

blocks.zh: Master Seed Lot — 原始菌株，從 ATCC 等認證機構購入
blocks.en: Master seed lot — the original strain, purchased from a recognized culture collection such as ATCC

blocks.zh: Working Seed Lot — 日常使用的工作菌株
blocks.en: Working seed lot — the working strain used day to day

blocks.zh: ≤ 5 代 — 工作菌株距離原始種批不超過 5 次繼代培養，以避免基因飄移
blocks.en: No more than 5 passages — the working strain must be no more than 5 passages removed from the original seed lot, to avoid genetic drift

blocks.zh: 懸浮液有效期限：室溫 2 小時，冷藏（2-8°C）24 小時。這個限制確保菌株活力。
blocks.en: Suspension shelf life: 2 hours at room temperature, or 24 hours refrigerated (2-8°C). This limit ensures the viability of the strain.

blocks.zh: 影印的影印：
blocks.en: A photocopy of a photocopy:

blocks.zh: 想像你有一份原始文件。每影印一次，品質就會略微下降。如果你拿第 10 代的影印本去影印，文字可能已經模糊不清了。菌株的繼代培養也是如此 — 每傳一代，菌株的特性可能會輕微改變。USP 限制在 5 代以內，就是確保你用來測試的「嫌犯照片」夠清晰，不會認錯人。
blocks.en: Imagine you have an original document. Every time you photocopy it, the quality drops slightly. If you photocopy a 10th-generation copy, the text may already be blurred beyond reading. Subculturing strains works the same way: with each passage, the characteristics of the strain may change slightly. USP limits you to 5 passages so that the "suspect's photo" you test with stays clear enough that you do not identify the wrong person.

blocks.zh: 陰性對照失敗 = 必須調查：這不是「重做一次就好」的事情。陰性對照長出微生物意味著你的整個測試環境可能被汙染，所有使用相同設備、培養基、緩衝液的測試結果都不可信。
blocks.en: Negative control failure = investigation required: This is not a matter of "just repeat it". Growth in the negative control means your whole test environment may be contaminated, and the results of every test that used the same equipment, media and buffers become unreliable.

blocks.zh: CDMO 常見問題：
blocks.en: Common CDMO problems:

blocks.zh: 菌株管理不善 — 沒有追蹤繼代次數
blocks.en: Poor strain management — passage numbers are not tracked

blocks.zh: 懸浮液超時使用 — 室溫放超過 2 小時
blocks.en: Suspensions used past their time limit — left at room temperature for more than 2 hours

blocks.zh: Clostridia 厭氧培養設備不足 — 沒有厭氧工作站或厭氧罐
blocks.en: Inadequate anaerobic incubation capability for Clostridia — no anaerobic workstation or anaerobic jars

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 允許使用 Clostridia 的孢子懸浮液而不是新鮮的營養體細胞？孢子懸浮液有什麼實務上的優勢？
blocks.en: Why does USP allow a spore suspension of Clostridia instead of fresh vegetative cells? What practical advantages does a spore suspension have?

blocks.zh: 如果你的陰性對照在培養 48 小時後出現一個菌落，你的調查計畫應該包含哪些項目？
blocks.en: If your negative control shows one colony after 48 hours of incubation, what items should your investigation plan include?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Candida albicans 的培養溫度（20-25°C）與細菌（30-35°C）不同？這反映了什麼微生物學原理？
blocks.en: Why is the incubation temperature for Candida albicans (20-25°C) different from that for bacteria (30-35°C)? What microbiological principle does this reflect?

blocks.zh: 0.4 Growth Promotion, Inhibitory & Indicative Properties of Media — 培養基的生長促進、抑制與指示特性
blocks.en: 0.4 Growth Promotion, Inhibitory & Indicative Properties of Media

blocks.zh: 培養基的三大驗證特性：這是 ⟨62⟩ 中最重要的基礎概念之一。每種選擇性培養基必須同時具備多種功能：
blocks.en: The three properties used to qualify media: This is one of the most important foundational concepts in ⟨62⟩. Each selective medium must combine several functions:

blocks.zh: Growth Promoting（生長促進） — 目標菌能長出來（≤ 100 cfu 接種，最短培養時間內可見生長）
blocks.en: Growth promoting — the target organism can grow (inoculum of ≤ 100 cfu, visible growth within the shortest incubation time)

blocks.zh: Inhibitory（抑制） — 非目標菌長不出來（≥ 100 cfu 接種，最長培養時間後仍無生長）
blocks.en: Inhibitory — non-target organisms cannot grow (inoculum of ≥ 100 cfu, no growth after the longest incubation time)

blocks.zh: Indicative（指示） — 目標菌長出來的菌落形態具有辨識特徵（如特定顏色、形狀）
blocks.en: Indicative — colonies of the target organism show distinguishing characteristics (for example, a specific color or shape)

blocks.zh: 接種量的巧妙設計：注意生長促進測試用 ≤ 100 cfu（少量就要長得出來），抑制測試用 ≥ 100 cfu（大量也不能長）。這確保了培養基的選擇性夠強。
blocks.en: The clever design of the inoculum levels: Note that the growth promotion test uses ≤ 100 cfu (even a small number must grow), while the inhibition test uses ≥ 100 cfu (even a large number must not grow). This ensures that the medium is sufficiently selective.

blocks.zh: 選才面試系統：
blocks.en: A talent-selection interview system:

blocks.zh: 把每種培養基想像成一個特殊設計的面試關卡：
blocks.en: Think of each medium as a specially designed interview stage:

blocks.zh: 生長促進 = 目標候選人即使只來一兩個，也能順利通過面試、表現出色
blocks.en: Growth promoting = even if only one or two target candidates show up, they pass the interview and perform well

blocks.zh: 抑制 = 不符合資格的人即使來了一大群，也全部被篩掉，一個都通不過
blocks.en: Inhibitory = unqualified people are all screened out, even if a whole crowd of them arrives; not one gets through

blocks.zh: 指示 = 通過面試的人會戴上特定顏色的識別證，讓你一眼就能認出來
blocks.en: Indicative = people who pass the interview wear a badge of a specific color, so you can recognize them at a glance

blocks.zh: 例如 MacConkey Agar：E. coli 能長（生長促進），S. aureus 長不出來（抑制），而且 E. coli 的菌落會呈現特定粉紅色（指示）。
blocks.en: For example, MacConkey Agar: E. coli grows (growth promoting), S. aureus does not (inhibitory), and E. coli colonies show a characteristic pink color (indicative).

blocks.zh: 每批培養基都要驗證：不管是現成培養基還是自行配製的，每一批都必須進行上述驗證。這是 GMP 實驗室中工作量最大的品管項目之一。
blocks.en: Every batch of medium must be tested: Whether the medium is ready-made or prepared in-house, every batch must undergo the tests above. This is one of the heaviest QC workloads in a GMP laboratory.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務考量：
blocks.en: CDMO practical considerations:

blocks.zh: 建議使用商業化的現成培養基（如 bioMerieux, BD, Merck），以減少配製變異
blocks.en: Use commercial ready-to-use media (such as bioMerieux, BD, Merck) where possible, to reduce preparation variability

blocks.zh: 保留每批培養基的生長促進測試記錄，作為 OOS/OOT 調查時的回溯依據
blocks.en: Keep the growth promotion test records for each medium batch, as a traceability basis for OOS/OOT investigations

blocks.zh: Table 1 是稽查員最常查看的表格之一 — 確保你的測試記錄與此表完全對應
blocks.en: Table 1 is one of the tables inspectors look at most often; make sure your test records correspond exactly to it

blocks.zh: 為什麼生長促進測試要用「最短培養時間」，而抑制測試要用「最長培養時間」？如果反過來會怎樣？
blocks.en: Why does the growth promotion test use the "shortest incubation time" while the inhibition test uses the "longest incubation time"? What would happen if it were the other way around?

blocks.zh: 如果一批 MacConkey Broth 的生長促進測試合格，但抑制測試失敗（S. aureus 長出來了），你會怎麼處理？這批培養基能用嗎？
blocks.en: A batch of MacConkey Broth passes the growth promotion test but fails the inhibition test (S. aureus grew). How would you handle it? Can this batch of medium be used?

blocks.zh: Table 1 中，為什麼有些培養基只需要驗證「Growth promoting」，有些則需要「Growth promoting + Indicative」？差別在哪裡？
blocks.en: In Table 1, why do some media require only "Growth promoting" while others require "Growth promoting + Indicative"? What is the difference?

blocks.zh: 0.5 Suitability of the Test Method — 測試方法適用性
blocks.en: 0.5 Suitability of the Test Method

blocks.zh: 方法適用性驗證（Method Suitability）：這是 ⟨62⟩ 測試的「驗證入門票」。你必須證明你的測試方法在特定產品存在的條件下，仍然能檢測到目標微生物。核心邏輯：
blocks.en: Method suitability: This is the "entry ticket" to ⟨62⟩ testing. You must show that your test method can still detect the target microorganisms in the presence of the specific product. The core logic:

blocks.zh: 在產品 + 培養基的混合物中加入 ≤ 100 cfu 的目標菌
blocks.en: Add ≤ 100 cfu of the target organism to the product + medium mixture

blocks.zh: 按照正常測試流程走完（使用最短培養時間）
blocks.en: Carry it through the normal test procedure (using the shortest incubation time)

blocks.zh: 如果能檢測到目標菌 → 方法適用
blocks.en: If the target organism is detected → the method is suitable

blocks.zh: 如果檢測不到 → 產品有抗菌活性，需要修改方法
blocks.en: If it is not detected → the product has antimicrobial activity and the method must be modified

blocks.zh: 「無法中和」的特殊規則：如果用盡一切方法都無法中和產品對某菌的抑制作用，USP 允許假設「該微生物不可能存在於此產品中」。這是實務上的務實安排。
blocks.en: The special rule for "cannot be neutralized": If, after every effort, the product's inhibitory effect on an organism cannot be neutralized, USP allows the assumption that "the organism is unlikely to be present in the product". This is a pragmatic arrangement in practice.

blocks.zh: 偵探的偵測能力測試：
blocks.en: A detective's detection-capability test:

blocks.zh: 在偵探正式辦案之前，你要先測試他能不能在「犯罪現場」（= 你的產品環境）中找到嫌犯。所以你故意在現場放一個已知的「假嫌犯」（= 100 cfu 測試菌），看偵探能不能找到他。如果連假嫌犯都找不到，這個偵探（= 測試方法）就不適合用在這個案件上。
blocks.en: Before a detective starts a real case, you first test whether he can find a suspect at the "crime scene" (= your product environment). So you deliberately plant a known "fake suspect" (= 100 cfu of test organism) at the scene and see whether the detective can find him. If he cannot even find the fake suspect, this detective (= the test method) is not suitable for this case.

blocks.zh: 而如果現場的環境本身就會「消滅嫌犯」（= 強效抗菌活性），那嫌犯根本不可能存活在這個環境中，你也就不需要擔心了。
blocks.en: And if the scene itself would "eliminate the suspect" (= strong antimicrobial activity), the suspect could not have survived in that environment in the first place, so there is nothing to worry about.

blocks.zh: 何時需要重新驗證：原文說「for each new product」— 每個新產品都需要做方法適用性驗證。此外，如果產品配方變更（如更換防腐劑）或測試條件變更（如更換培養基供應商），也需要重新驗證。
blocks.en: When revalidation is needed: The text says "for each new product", so every new product needs method suitability testing. In addition, if the product formulation changes (for example, a different preservative) or the test conditions change (for example, a different medium supplier), revalidation is also required.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的特殊挑戰：作為代工廠，你承接多個客戶、多種產品。每個新產品都意味著一輪新的方法適用性驗證。建議建立「產品分類系統」— 將配方相似的產品分組，以「最具挑戰性的產品」做代表性驗證。
blocks.en: The special challenge for CDMOs: As a contract manufacturer, you take on multiple clients and many products. Every new product means another round of method suitability testing. It is advisable to build a "product grouping system": group products with similar formulations and use the "most challenging product" as the representative for validation.

blocks.zh: 一個含 0.5% Chlorhexidine 的口腔漱洗液，在 ⟨62⟩ 方法適用性驗證中無法檢測到 S. aureus。你有哪些中和策略可以嘗試？
blocks.en: A mouthwash containing 0.5% chlorhexidine fails to show S. aureus in the ⟨62⟩ method suitability test. What neutralization strategies could you try?

blocks.zh: 如果最終確認某產品對 P. aeruginosa 的抗菌活性無法中和，你在測試報告中應該如何記載？這個結論是否需要額外的科學數據支持？
blocks.en: If it is finally confirmed that a product's antimicrobial activity against P. aeruginosa cannot be neutralized, how should you document this in the test report? Does this conclusion require additional scientific data to support it?

blocks.zh: 為什麼方法適用性驗證使用「最短培養時間」而非「最長」？這與生長促進測試的邏輯一致嗎？
blocks.en: Why does method suitability testing use the "shortest incubation time" rather than the "longest"? Is this consistent with the logic of the growth promotion test?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: USP ⟨62⟩ 是強制性章節（<1000），針對非無菌產品中 6 種特定微生物進行定性/半定量檢測
blocks.en: USP ⟨62⟩ is a mandatory chapter (numbered below 1000) that provides qualitative/semi-quantitative testing for 6 specified microorganisms in nonsterile products

blocks.zh: 樣品製備依照 ⟨61⟩ 進行，包括 1:10 稀釋、抗菌活性中和、表面活性劑毒性確認
blocks.en: Sample preparation follows ⟨61⟩, including the 1:10 dilution, neutralization of antimicrobial activity, and confirmation that surfactants are not toxic

blocks.zh: 菌株管理採用 Seed-Lot System，工作菌株 ≤ 5 代；懸浮液室溫 2 小時、冷藏 24 小時有效
blocks.en: Strain management uses a seed-lot system with working strains of no more than 5 passages; suspensions are valid for 2 hours at room temperature or 24 hours refrigerated

blocks.zh: 培養基驗證包含三大特性：生長促進（≤100 cfu，最短時間）、抑制（≥100 cfu，最長時間）、指示（菌落形態比對）
blocks.en: Media qualification covers three properties: growth promoting (≤100 cfu, shortest time), inhibitory (≥100 cfu, longest time) and indicative (colony morphology comparison)

blocks.zh: 陰性對照失敗必須啟動調查，不能簡單重測了事
blocks.en: A negative control failure must trigger an investigation; it cannot be dealt with by simply retesting

blocks.zh: 方法適用性必須針對每個新產品進行驗證；無法中和抗菌活性時可假設該菌不存在於產品中
blocks.en: Method suitability must be demonstrated for each new product; when antimicrobial activity cannot be neutralized, it may be assumed that the organism is not present in the product

blocks.zh: CDMO 連結：進料檢測、培養基品管、多產品方法驗證策略是日常營運的核心挑戰
blocks.en: CDMO link: incoming material testing, media QC and a multi-product method validation strategy are core challenges of day-to-day operations
